title: Mount an ISO image as a loop device
summary: Use udisksctl to mount an ISO image file as a read-only loop device. This allows you to browse the contents of the ISO without burning it to a disk.

steps.explain: Mount the ISO image as a read-only loop device. Replace <ISO_FILE> with the path to your ISO file.

placeholders.name: ISO_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the ISO image file

steps.expect: Output indicating the loop device has been created and the ISO is ready to mount.
